newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait calls for Moslem prayers to mark eclipse.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait calls for Moslem prayers to mark eclipse.

text.p: Kuwait urged Moslem citizens and residents to hold prayers on Friday to mark a lunar eclipse.
The Ministry of Islamic Affairs urged Moslems in the Gulf Arab state to follow the Prophet Mohammad's tradition to pray when a complete eclipse is seen, local newspapers reported.
Earth's shadow is expected to block out the full moon over Kuwait shortly before dawn (0100 GMT) on Friday.
